events.title: Inflation crossed 50% (reached 58%)
events.detail: Consumer price inflation rose from 38.1% to 57.8%, crossing the 50% threshold.
events.source: derived: World Bank consumer price inflation
events.contested: The 50% line is a convention, not a natural boundary. Official inflation statistics are also among the most manipulated numbers governments publish, so the true figure may be higher than the one recorded here.

events.title: Output collapse: GDP per capita fell 13%
events.detail: Real GDP per capita fell from 3,805 to 3,325 (constant 2015 US$) in a single year.
events.source: derived: World Bank GDP per capita
events.contested: A one-year collapse of this size usually has several causes at once - war, currency crisis, commodity price, or the end of a political order. This marker says it happened; it does not say why.

events.title: The Fujishock stabilisation
events.detail: Fuel and food prices were freed overnight, subsidies removed and the exchange rate unified, ending hyperinflation that had exceeded 7,000% a year.
events.contested: Inflation stopped quickly and poverty rose sharply in the short run. The stabilisation is also inseparable from the 1992 self-coup that followed, which raises the recurring question of whether the two were connected by necessity or only by circumstance.
events.refs: ["Banco Central de Reserva del Per\u00fa, Memoria 1990"]
